Brabantia in Pelt is looking for Warehouse Operators!
 

Are you looking for a varied job in an international company? Then we are looking for you!
 

As a Warehouse Operator, you will be responsible for the following tasks:
 

 
• Manually picking orders
 
• Packing and labelling products
 
• Processing shipping documents
 
• Working with handheld scanners 
 

You will also help keep the working environment clean and tidy. You always work safely and support your colleagues whenever needed.

As a Warehouse Operator at Brabantia, you will have a varied range of tasks.
 

 
• You are available to work in 2 shifts: from 5:30 AM to 2:00 PM and from 2:00 PM to 10:30 PM. On Fridays, the early shift is from 5:30 AM to 1:00 PM and the late shift from 1:00 PM to 8:30 PM
 
• You will work with handheld scanners and computer programs
 
• Experience with these tools or the motivation to learn how to use them is therefore essential
 
• You have experience operating an electric pallet truck or are willing to follow an internal training
 
• You have your own means of transportation, as Brabantia is not accessible by public transport
 
• You speak English fluently

FILOform, part of the CRH group, is an innovative solution-focused development and manufacturing company. They focus on smart solutions for connecting, sealing and protecting underground cable, fibre optics and utility networks.

For over 60 years FILOform has broadend their international and domestic network. With their HQ located in the UK and sites in The Netherlands and Germany, their global network is expanding every day. They currently export their products over 30 countries worldwide and provide worldwide support to a wide variety of industries, focusing on Telecom, Datacenters, Infrastructure and Energy. 

In order to broaden and complete their sealing portfolio, FILOform has joined forces with Wallmax, resulting in additional innovative solutions for their clients and prospects.

To secure the introduction and development of the FILOform & Wallmax portfolio, within sealing, protection and cable management solutions, we are currently recruiting a Technical Sales Engineer.

Jobomschrijving

You will be accountable for the introduction and development of the FILOform & Wallmax product portfolio within Belgium. You will initiate and implement the local sales strategy securing a solid market share for your region.

• You will step up, maintain, expand and develop long-term relationships with new & existing clients in order to achieve and exceed sales targets.
• You will proactively identify and pursue business opportunities across diverse industries such as Telecom, Datacenters, Infrastructure and Energy. By ensuring a close interaction with your key stakeholders you keep abreast on upcoming projects and needs.
• You are able to translate your customer’s challenges into qualitative solutions, ensuring fulfillment of their business needs whilst pursuing customer satisfaction, through dedicated business partnering.
• You will keep abreast of market trends and data, related to the FILOform & Wallmax Product Portfolio and industries, to identify and determine market opportunities, increase the business market share and secure further market penetration.
• You will present business reports, sales reports and forecasts on a monthly basis.
• You will liaise with internal and external stakeholders across all sites, as appropriate.
• You will be updating the CRM tools (Salesforce, …).
• You will report directly to the Sales Manager BENE with who you will have close interactions and regular meetings.

• Bachelor or Master background combined with a senior technical sales experience with a proven track record and client portfolio within the Energy, Infrastructure, Data or Telecom sector. 
• Demonstrated history of achieving sales targets, growing revenue, analyzing and following-up on KPI’s.
• Able to quickly master and understand all technical aspects of the business and flexible towards new product introductions.
• Able to manage long and complex commercial- and product approval processes.
• Used to work in an innovative environment with a strong international and customer-oriented mindset.
• Reliable and valuable business partner assuring strong stakeholder management.
• Strong analytical skillset with the ability to effectively analyze market trends and customer needs.
• Experience in tender management is a plus.
• You are based in Belgium and are flexible to travel across the country to visit clients.
• Flexible to travel to The Netherlands and/or UK when required (limited).
• This role is a stand alone role that is mainly managed from a Home Office setting.
• You are fluent in English, Dutch and French.

The Role: Senior International Pricing Analyst
 

Location: Mechelen, Belgium 
(1-2 days a week on site)
 

 
 

Come make the world and accelerate your success.
 

It takes great people to achieve greatness. People with a sense of purpose and integrity. People with a relentless pursuit of excellence. People who care about making things better For Those Who Make The World™. Sound like you? Join our top-notch team of approximately 43,500 diverse and high-performing professionals globally who are making their mark on some of the world’s most beloved brands, including DEWALT®, BLACK+DECKER®, CRAFTSMAN®, STANLEY®, CUB CADET®, and HUSTLER®.
 

 
 

The Job:
 

 
 

Are you a commercially minded analyst with a passion for pricing, profitability, and turning data into action? We are looking for a Senior International Pricing analyst to help drive profitable growth across our International region.
 

 
 

What You’ll Do:
 
 

• Analyze price/volume/mix, discount and margin performance across the International business to identify risks, margin leakage, discounting behaviour, mix shifts, inflation and corrective opportunities 

• Deliver timely and accurate reporting, dashboards and insights to support pricing governance and business decision-making. 

• Partner with Sales, Finance, Commercial and global teams to evaluate brand and customer profitability, innovation pricing and deal economics. 

• Build financial models and scenario analyses to assess the impact of pricing changes and support strategic recommendations. 

• Actively expand data collection and processing of market-based metrics (consumer prices, competitive positioning 

• Strong contributor for strategic value-based Price List and RRP maintenance, and price architecture 

Who You Are 
 

 
 

We are seeking someone with strong analytical capability, sharp business acumen, and the confidence to influence stakeholders in a dynamic, matrixed environment. If you are curious, detail-oriented, accountable, and motivated by making a measurable business impact, we would love to hear from you:
 

 
 
 

• Candidates must hold a 
relevant degree in Finance, Economics, Data Analytics or a related discipline.  
 

• Experience in pricing, commercial finance, margin management, or business analytics in a leading consumer packaged goods (CPG) company or other companies with strong marketing 

• Advanced proficiency in 
Excel and experience with reporting and visualization tools such as 
Power BI. 

• Fluent in English, additional European language is a plus.

Are you passionate about cutting-edge technology?

Do you thrive on ensuring products meet the highest standards of performance and reliability?

As a Test & Validation Engineer you will be instrumental in validating advanced imaging systems, from prototype to industrialization, ensuring they meet both customer and regulatory standards. You will also mentor junior engineers and drive continuous improvement in our testing processes.

Key Responsibilities:

• Define and implement validation and verification plans for new products and platforms.

• Develop test protocols, acceptance criteria and traceability matrices.

• Conduct hands-on testing of sensors, cameras, and modules, covering electrical, optical, mechanical and environmental aspects.

• Automate test procedures using LabVIEW, Python or similar tools.

• Analyze test results, identify root causes and propose corrective actions.

• Improve test methodologies, tools and infrastructure to support scalable industrialization.

• Collaborate with R&D, project management, quality and operations teams to support design reviews and product improvements.

• Mentor junior engineers and share best practices within the team.

• Master’s degree in Electronics, Physics, Optics, or related engineering field.

• Min. 5-7 years of experience in test engineering, validation, or reliability engineering in a high-tech environment 

• Hands-on experience with test automation (Python expertise needed).

• Familiarity with optical/electro-optical testing is a strong plus.

• Strong analytical and problem-solving skills; ability to get to root causes.

• Excellent communication skills; capable of writing clear technical documentation and presenting to stakeholders.

• Ability to mentor and guide less experienced engineers.

• Fluent in English; knowledge of Dutch is a plus.

Are you a real night owl and do you enjoy an active, hands-on job? Then we may have the perfect job for you! We are looking for a motivated Warehouse Operator to join the permanent night shift. You will work for a stable and growing company where you can count on proper training, a great team atmosphere and an attractive salary package. Your responsibilities As a Warehouse Operator, you play an important role in the logistics process. You make sure that goods are processed correctly and that orders are ready for shipment. Your tasks include:
 

 
• Receiving, checking and storing incoming goods
 
• Picking orders using voice picking and/or scanning
 
• Preparing orders accurately and on time for transport
 
• Loading and unloading trucks
 
• Moving goods using an electric pallet truck and/or reach truck
 
• Keeping the warehouse clean, organised and safe
 
• Following safety, hygiene and quality procedures (HACCP)
 
• Working in a chilled environment, including a freezer area 

Who are we looking for? You don't need years of experience for this position. Motivation and the right attitude are just as important! We are looking for someone who:
 

 
• Preferably has experience as a warehouse operator, although motivated candidates without experience are also welcome
 
• Works accurately and responsibly
 
• Is not afraid of physical work and enjoys being hands-on
 
• Can work independently as well as in a team
 
• Speaks and understands Dutch and/or English
 
• Has experience with an electric pallet truck or reach truck (a valid certificate is a plus)
 
• Is comfortable working in a cold/freezer environment
 
• Is willing to work the permanent night shift

jobs.occupation: Graduate Management Traineeship Programme (GMT) - Belgium M/W/X
jobs.description:
#Talent 

 

Launch Your Career with AB InBev: Graduate Management Trainee Program 

 

What is it? 

 

Our Graduate Management Trainee (GMT) programme is a  

• 10 months program starting in August 2027 
• 3-4-month rotations within the program 
• As a junior talent, you will work on real business projects situated in Sales, Commercial, Supply & Logistics 
• You will have a 70-20-10 learning and development approach, where 70% Learning on the Job, 20% Exposure to Other, 10% Formal Learning & Training 
 

Who are we looking for? 

 

You are willing to become a future leader within AB InBev, and should be comfortable with an ambiguous career track, and expect geographic mobility. 
The following qualities describe you: Leader. Proud Owner. Agile Learner. Collaborator. Future Maker. 

 
To be eligible: 

• You must have graduated (before September 2027 and no more than two years prior) with a Bachelor's, Master's (or equivalent) degree. 
• You should also have no more than 2 years of professional experience (internships/volunteers/student jobs not included). 
• Your passion and ownership are more important than the subject you studied. 
• Fluent English is needed, as well as the native language of the country you are applying in. 
• A valid permanent visa/work permit is required in the country of application to be eligible for the programme. 
• During the 10-month program and beyond, you might be required to travel within your country of application and across Europe. 
 

We are looking for: Junior talent. Recent Graduate. Junior Manager. Professional Trainee. Graduate Trainee. 
 
How can you apply? 

 

• Before you apply, check more information https://europecareers.ab-inbev.com/programmes/graduate-management-traineeship  
• Please be advised that you will only be considered for the first application you submit, therefore please make sure you are completely happy with your choice as this decision is final. 
• There is no need to upload a cover letter - this will not affect your application. 
 

Good to know 

 

• Our Graduate Management Trainee Programme is the first step to an amazing career at AB InBev. 
• Post-Programme, you will pursue a rewarding career, often within our core functions at the heart of our business within Sales, Commercial, Supply & Logistics. 
• GMT programme will give you valuable exposure and insights into leading and transforming a successful global business. You will work on real projects with senior stakeholders to drive value and undertake a structured program to support your development as a future leader. 
 

What do we offer? 

 

Next to a competitive base salary, we put our people first by providing additional benefits: 

• Learning & Development opportunities  
• Quarterly vouchers to taste our delicious beers 
• Legal holidays + Compensation & additional days (40 Days in total for fulltime employment) 
• A unique Parental leave 
• Multiple Physical & Mental Wellbeing support Initiatives 
• Meal vouchers, allowances, gift per company policy 
• Competitive Life insurance, disability & medical plan 
• A Flexible Rewards system - (smartphone, bike lease, Extra pension Plan, etc.) 
 

Where? 
  

The GMT programme is available in: 
 
¿    Belgium 
¿    France 
¿    Germany 
¿    Italy 
¿    Netherlands 
¿    United Kingdom 
  

Build your career with us 
We recruit for mindset, ambition, cultural fit, and growth opportunities. 
 
UNIQUE CULTURE 
We are proud to be part of something bigger than ourselves and are passionate about building upon our company's long legacy. We believe in collaboration and candor, which results in a dynamic culture with open communication. 
  
BRANDS EVERYONE LOVES 
We are part of the collective, global history of beer. We are the proud makers of more than 500 iconic brands, from beloved international classics to local favorites. 
  
GROWTH OPPORTUNITIES 
Our people grow at the pace of their talent. We empower our people to learn, expand their perspectives, and unlock career growth. In an environment where commitment to excellence pays off, our people are able to deepen their impact and create a long-lasting legacy.
